payment_amount.description: Amount received as payment toward the outstanding credit balance, expressed in US dollars.

payment_bank_account.description: Masked identifier for the bank account used to make the payment; original account number is replaced with a non-identifying numeric code for security.

payment_date.description: The calendar date when a borrower’s payment was recorded as received.

return_reason.description: Reason provided for a payment reversal, applicable when the payment has been flagged as returned.
